name: Ikhlas Paling Serius
overview: Fajar was raised by his mother, Winda, after his father died when he was a baby. Their bond is close but shaped by hardship. As an adult, he works as the personal assistant to Farah—a strict, perfectionist boss hiding deep emotional wounds. Secretly assigned by Willie, Farah’s childhood friend, to spy on her, Fajar instead falls in love. They begin a hidden relationship, kept from everyone, including Willie and their families. Complications arise with Alya, Fajar’s childhood friend, and Marsha from his past. Under pressure, Fajar and Farah must choose their happiness, even if it means breaking hearts.
